opennyai_summary.decision:
.  It appears that despite directions in order under contempt, no steps are taken by respondent No.3/Collector to pass an award under The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (New Act) in respect of acquisition of land.
Even under order dated 04.11.2025, this Court had directed the respondents to complete the entire exercise and payment of compensation within two months.
Still, no steps are taken by the respondents.
